summary: Build practical AI fairness skills in bias assessment, representative data, and governance. Explore the five-day programme and its applied outputs.
lede: AI fairness training helps AI product owners, data scientists and governance professionals assess bias in AI-enabled decisions. Participants practise selecting fairness metrics, reviewing representative data, comparing mitigation options and documenting findings with Model Cards, then develop a fairness policy and action plan informed by the NIST AI Risk Management Framework; advanced model engineering is covered at an overview level.
audienceIntro: This advanced programme suits professionals who shape, assess, govern, or review AI-enabled decisions and need to connect technical fairness evidence with organizational policy.
modules: AI Fairness Policy and Action Plan
prerequisites: Expected preparation: working knowledge of AI-enabled products or services and familiarity with data, governance, legal, DEI, or compliance responsibilities. Coding is not required; exercises use Excel and supplied example data. Fairlearn and AI Fairness 360 are introduced at operational overview level rather than through programming labs.
